CREATE PROCEDURE CDN.PoliczCyfreKontrolnaGLN @GLN varchar(12), @CyfraKontrolna int OUTPUT
AS
DECLARE @i int DECLARE @SumA int DECLARE @SumB int DECLARE @Sum int
IF LEN(@GLN) <> 12 BEGIN RAISERROR('Niepoprawna dlugość numeru GLN',16,1) RETURN 1 END ELSE BEGIN Set @i = 1 WHILE @i <= 12 BEGIN IF ASCII(SUBSTRING(@GLN,@i,1)) < 48 or ASCII(SUBSTRING(@GLN,@i,1)) > 57 BEGIN RAISERROR('Numer GLN może zawierać tylko cyfry',16,1) RETURN 2 END Set @i = @i + 1 END
Set @SumA = 0 Set @SumB = 0 Set @i = 1 WHILE @i <= 12 BEGIN IF @i%2=0 Set @SumB = @SumB + CAST(SUBSTRING(@GLN,@i,1) as int) ELSE Set @SumA = @SumA + CAST(SUBSTRING(@GLN,@i,1) as int) Set @i = @i + 1 END
Set @SumB = @SumB*3 Set @Sum = (@SumA + @SumB)%10 Set @CyfraKontrolna = (10-@Sum)%10 END RETURN 0
